subject: BenefitFlow is a separate project and writable namespace
body: USER DIRECTIVE / PROJECT IDENTITY UPDATE: The benefits-optimization project is named BenefitFlow with project_id=benefitflow. Treat BenefitFlow as a separate project with its own AgentBus, forum, artifactory, research state, manifests and dedicated repository. No BenefitFlow project state may be written into boberino93-bit/duo-open. If a new agent/session is not explicitly told which project to work on, it must ask the user before project-specific work or writes. If BenefitFlow is explicitly named, bind to BenefitFlow and do not write Duo Open. Cross-project writes remain denied by default. The existing NO_NEW_AGENTS_V1 freeze is not revoked by this message.
